reviewTarget.description: 尺寸 / 文字 / 引线标准内容框

userFindings.finding: 框内内容看上去像乱码，内容本身不对，导致不能作为文字 / 引线标准复用。
左侧内容与框边重合，存在视觉冲突。
整体不美观，不能作为系统资产仓库的可读样例。
乱码和内容不正确导致不能实际复用。
后续 Agent 是否能检索、理解并搜索到这些沉淀样式，需要单独审计。

rootCauseHypothesis: Current visualReadabilityAudit checks broad aisle, density, layer semantics, and source/proof separation, but does not inspect semantic correctness of the content inside A2 sample frames.
Current clearance audit can pass when entities do not overlap protected content, but it does not catch content touching a local frame edge inside a sample card.
Current asset verification can record reuse probes and readback, but it does not prove the reusable style content is human-readable, non-garbled, or discoverable by future agents.

neededReviewerDimensions.description: 是否美观、整洁、专业，是否符合系统资产仓库的展示质量。
是否有遮挡、裁剪、压边、贴边、错位、局部不对齐、内容和框线重合。
框内内容是否真的是目标标准的正确表达，而不是乱码、伪图形、错误文字或无意义样例。
资产是否可以被后续 CAD 工作流实际复用，sourceSpec / style_definition / included handles / import plan 是否清楚。
资产是否能被其它 Agent 检索到，aliases、matchText、tags、useWhen、constraints、evidence refs 是否足够。
哪些结论来自截图、哪些来自 CAD readback、哪些来自 registry / assets.json、哪些仍需用户验收。

shortTerm: Mark A2 human visual review as failed and do not claim A2 visual acceptance.
Generate a scoped repair plan for A2 only; target bbox should be A2_ANNOTATION_STYLES and any concrete failing handles if readback can locate them.
Before CAD repair, define the correct A2 content contract: which text style samples, dimension samples, and leader samples should appear, with readable labels and margins.
After repair, rerun CAD readback and capture a new A2 crop.
reviewerUpgrade: Extend visual layout reviewer schema with aestheticQualityAcceptable, noLocalFrameCollision, contentSemanticsCorrect, reusableSourceClear, retrievalMetadataSufficient.
Fail visual_layout_review when any sample frame contains garbled text, text touching local frame, unreadable labels, or content that cannot be mapped to an asset / style definition.
Use user feedback as positive/negative training example for model-backed reviewer prompts.
assetWorkflowUpgrade: For style_standard assets, separate visual proof panel from reusable source definition more explicitly.
Require a reuse readiness audit: sourceSpec, style definition name, import / apply plan, readback replay, and savedCurrentDwg=false.
Require retrieval readiness audit: registry aliases / tags / matchText / useWhen should contain the user-facing Chinese intent and technical style keywords.
